record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare STONE_EDGE: Binacle (1 star) and Barbaracle (2 stars), both maxPP 65, range 1, no passive. Units are bound by the queue record only.

dispatch.routingNote: NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT: STONE_EDGE is both the Ability and an EffectEnum flag. The strategy sets the flag on the caster; the flag is read in PokemonState.attack (basic attack bonus) and removed by the delayed command.

record.summary: Self-buff of the caster for a fixed duration (5 s at 1 star, 8 s at 2 stars; 10 s at 3 or more): the caster silences itself for that duration, gains +20 crit chance (AP-scaled), +2 range, and every basic attack it makes while the effect is active adds physical damage equal to DEF x (multiplier + AP/100) with multiplier 1/1/2/4 by stars. A delayed command at the end of the duration removes 20 crit chance, 2 range (not below baseRange) and the effect flag. If the flag is already active the cast only spends its PP and does nothing else. There is no target: requiresTarget is false, so the cast can fire from the moving state.

targeting.note: The target parameter is typed null; the strategy never reads it. requiresTarget = false lets the cast fire from the moving state with a null target.

effects.scaling: requested duration = table seconds x 1000 ms. triggerSilence(duration, pokemon, pokemon): blocked entirely by Rune Protect or the tree status; x1.3 in MURKY weather; then applyStatusDurationReductions; the cooldown is raised only when the new duration is longer than the current silence. Silence makes canCast false, so the caster cannot cast again until it ends. The delayed revert below uses the unmodified requested duration, not the adjusted silence duration.
effects.resolution: requested 5000 / 8000 ms -> applied silence duration may differ (weather, reductions, existing longer silence, or no silence under Rune Protect); the buff window is always the requested duration

effects.scaling: The flag is added after the silence call and removed by a DelayedCommand with the requested duration; while the flag is present a further cast returns right after super.process.
effects.resolution: cast while active: PP spent, nothing else changes; the flag and the revert are not extended

effects.scaling: requested +20. applied by addCritChance: value x (1 + 1 x AP/100) (crit is false), then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, holder only, because a buff or an own-team loss counts) and Twist Band (only flips negative values from another team, so not here), then critChance += value; above 100 the overflow is converted to crit power (+round(excess)) and critChance is set to 100. The revert calls addCritChance(-20, ..., apBoost 1) with the AP and items at the time of the revert, so the amount removed can differ from the amount added (different AP, Big Eater Belt gained or lost, and any value already clipped at 100, whose overflow crit power is not undone).
effects.resolution: requested +20 -> applied +20 x (1 + AP/100) (x1.25 down with Big Eater Belt) at cast; requested -20 -> applied by the same formula at revert; the net change is not guaranteed to be zero

effects.scaling: requested +2, applied as a plain field increase (no helper, no AP, no Big Eater Belt). The revert subtracts 2 but never goes below baseRange; the flag guard prevents a second +2 while active.
effects.resolution: +2 range for the requested duration, then range = max(baseRange, range - 2)

effects.target: the caster's basic-attack target while the flag is set

declaredRaw.damageType: PHYSICAL (added to the attack's physical part)

effects.scaling: requested bonus = the caster's current DEF x (stars multiplier + AP/100), added to physicalDamage before the single Math.round of the attack, with no crit multiplier of its own (the crit factor is applied to `damage` earlier). It then goes through target.handleDamage as PHYSICAL (target DEF reduction, ceil and floor of 1: core-mechanics section A), merged with the rest of the physical part. The line comes after the dodge and protect zeroing of `damage`, and it has no isAttackSuccessful guard in the lines read; Protect on the target is handled inside handleDamage. The returned takenDamage is summed into the attack's total.
effects.resolution: requested DEF x (1 + AP/100) for both listed units (multiplier 1) -> merged into the rounded physical part -> final HP loss after the target's DEF, shield and the section J1 exceptions

statusEffects.guards: Rune Protect or tree block it; MURKY weather x1.3; applyStatusDurationReductions; a longer existing silence is kept

buffs.raw: +2, reverted after the duration (floored at baseRange)

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3- and 4-star values (10 s; multiplier 2 and 4) are not reachable at the factory star counts of these units. Whether other mechanics change an entity's star count was not examined. The +20 crit chance and +2 range do not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy; range 1 + 2 = 3 for the duration changes where the unit can attack from, which the movement code decides.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: A cast while the flag is set only spends PP. After the revert the unit can cast again (silence must have ended first). No stored mode other than the flag.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: self-silence 5 s / 8 s, crit chance +20, range +2, and basic-attack bonus DEF x (1 + AP/100) for 1- and 2-star casters. Applied: crit chance +20 x (1 + AP/100) (Big Eater Belt x1.25 down), clipped at 100 with overflow turned into crit power; silence duration through weather and reductions or not at all under Rune Protect; the DEF bonus is rounded with the rest of the attack and reduced by the target's DEF. The revert is not a guaranteed exact inverse of the crit chance gain.
